vocabulary.definition: the reason or reasons one has for acting or behaving in a particular way
vocabulary.example: Money was the main motivation for changing jobs.

vocabulary.definition: become aware or conscious of (something); interpret or regard in a particular way
vocabulary.example: She perceived the criticism as constructive feedback.

vocabulary.definition: the results or effects of an action or condition
vocabulary.example: He had to face the consequences of his reckless behavior.

vocabulary.definition: to lessen or absorb the shock of an impact; to protect against harm or inconvenience
